DeployBot: [AUTOMATED] Hotfix candidate deployed to staging for service=edge-cache, region=eu-west1, image=redwood/edge-cache:sha-12ab3c. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/edge-cache-memory
Priya: hitting repeated OOMs on prod eu-west1 edge-cache; staging reproduces. need expedited approval to push hotfix to prod and skip canary window. rollback plan included. cc @Sam @Alex
Sam: can you paste the minimal release note we show to CS? also confirm whether this is a config or code change
Priya: code patch — fixes an allocation regression in the kv-serializer. release note: "edge-cache: fix memory regression causing OOMs under heavy prefix loads (eu-west1)."
Alex: what are rollback criteria? if the fix regresses, how fast can we pin back? also what's expected p95 latency delta? need numbers to greenlight skip-canary
Priya: rollback: image rollback to redwood/edge-cache:sha-9f8e7d (tested). we can roll back via `kubectl set image` in <5m. telemetry check: p95 expected +0-3ms, mem usage drop ~30% in staging
Jen: tagging security/scanning: image passed vuln scan earlier today. I approve from sec perspective. :white_check_mark:
Maya: I'm oncall for eu; I approve skipping canary if we keep 10% traffic initial and manual ramp. :thumbsup:
Sam: release note ack. adding blurb to release notes and notify CS: "Hotfix: edge-cache memory regression; targeted eu-west1; rolling 10% -> 50% -> 100% if green."
Priya: planned actions:
1) push image to prod eu-west1 pinned to sha-12ab3c
2) route 10% traffic for 5m, monitor p95/ooms/errats
3) if stable -> 50% for 10m -> 100%
4) rollback immediately if >1% 5xx or OOM observed
Command I'll run:
```
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/edge-cache --image=redwood/edge-cache:sha-12ab3c
kubectl set image deploy/edge-cache edge-cache=redwood/edge-cache:sha-12ab3c -n infra
```
Alex: okay with the rollback criteria. make sure tracing spans exported and alert on memory >80% baseline. I approve expedited push.
Priya: tagging ReleaseBot to create release note and start prod window. @ReleaseBot please create release and trigger deploybot when ready
ReleaseBot: Created release 2026-03-21-edge-cache-hotfix. Release notes saved. Notifying DeployBot to schedule immediate rollout.
DeployBot: Initiating rollout to prod eu-west1. Stage=10% traffic. Starting at 6504218950. Operator=Priya
Priya: starting rollout now. watching logs and mem graphs: https://metrics/redwood/edge-cache/eu-west1
Maya: seeing mem drop on staging mirror, good sign. keep me posted.
Sam: posting release note to #customer-updates and updating internal slack template.
DeployBot: Stage=10% -> health check ok (6504219010). No OOMs, p95 +1ms. Proceeding to 50% in 5m.
Priya: moving to 50% - monitoring.
DeployBot: Stage=50% -> health check ok (6504219075). No regressions observed. Proceeding to 100%.
DeployBot: Stage=100% -> SUCCESS (6504219123). No elevated 5xx or OOM alerts. Hotfix live in eu-west1.
Priya: thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a brief postmortem and the exact timeline in #postmortems. Closing thread. :tada:
